integrity: All-set support characterization and minimal-set count follow from an explicit general proof. Reproducible exhaustive tests for factors of orders 2–4 are corroborative only. No independent audit or external mathematical certification has been performed.
limitations: Exact for rectangular rook graphs with both complete factors of order at least two; no extension to longer products, weighted placements, fault tolerance, or altered propagation. Previously known minimum size is not claimed as new. Earlier equivalent enumerations might be poorly indexed. Full text of a relevant 2014 minimum-number paper was not accessible; accessible indexed passages were compared.
title: Power-domination support criterion and minimal-set spectrum of rectangular rook graphs
